purpose: Reserve article image geometry before network completion and validate local image attributes at build time.

policy.metadataSource: Astro imageMetadata on local public asset bytes only; containment checks also resolve symlinks.
policy.automaticScope: Markdown image HAST nodes with /assets/ URLs; raw HTML images need explicit attributes.
policy.loading: First Markdown image eager by default; subsequent images lazy; explicit properties retained.
policy.decoding: async by default; explicit properties retained.
policy.buildGate: Positive integer dimensions, declared loading/decoding, actual SVG viewBox ratio; normal and isolated builds.

browser.limits: Reserved image geometry only; not a field Core Web Vitals or search ranking measurement.

limits: The delayed-load browser measurement proves reserved geometry for one real article at two widths, not field CLS, LCP, or search ranking gains.
Existing rendered alt/source preservation checked; no new semantic alt review or article fact checking.
Raster dimensions have a parser test; the current 72 public article images are SVG.
